findings.message: Outcome guarantee or absolute claim; not allowed in dental advertising.
Chatbot residue left in the draft.

findings.quote: and every implant we place comes with a lifetime guarantee
findings.why: A lifetime guarantee is an unsupported promise about outcomes that the ADA advertising rules prohibit, and the post itself says no dentist can predict how long a restoration will last.
findings.fix: Delete the guarantee sentence and replace it with a neutral statement such as 'Dr. Elena Marsh places dental implants at our Austin office; ask us about the care plan during your consultation.'

findings.quote: I hope this helps! Let me know if you would like me to adjust the tone or add a section on costs.
findings.why: This is a conversational reply to the author, not patient-facing content, and would appear verbatim on the published page.
findings.fix: Remove both sentences entirely before publishing.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: This disclaimer tells readers the practice is fictional and the post is sample content, which would mislead patients if the post went live for the real clinic; it also conflicts with publishing it as clinic guidance.
findings.fix: Remove the disclaimer for publication, or keep it only in the internal demo build and not in the public post body.

findings.why: I cannot verify from this review that this URL resolves or that the page says what the sentence claims about bridge construction.
findings.fix: Open the link, confirm it loads and supports the sentence, and note the access date if needed.

findings.why: I cannot verify from this review that this NIDCR URL exists or covers daily implant upkeep.
findings.fix: Confirm the link resolves on nidcr.nih.gov and that the page covers daily implant maintenance before publishing.

findings.quote: most patients describe soreness afterward rather than sharp pain
findings.why: The general pain description is plausible but makes a patient-experience generalization with no source.
findings.fix: Soften to 'Many patients report soreness afterward; your dentist will explain how to manage it' or cite a source.

findings.quote: a bridge is typically completed in fewer visits
findings.why: The visit-count comparison is a general statement with no source or ficha support.
findings.fix: Phrase it as 'treatment timelines vary; ask your dentist how many visits each option would need for your case.'

findings.why: The ficha lists Dr. Oyelaran's focus as family, pediatric dentistry and clear aligners, not implants, so a medical review attribution on an implant post may imply expertise the ficha does not show.
findings.fix: Confirm the reviewer's role for this topic or attribute the review to a dentist whose ficha focus covers dental implants.

findings.quote: Neither is right for everyone, and the choice depends on your health, your bone and your goals.
findings.why: The stock 'neither is right for everyone' framing and the three-part list read as generic AI-style phrasing.
findings.fix: Rewrite in a more specific clinic voice, for example naming the factors Dr. Marsh checks at a consultation.
